UPCC3_-_PRIMLibrary_Abstract_Syntax:Valu.definition: The modelling of lane management in dynamic lane management zones and carriageway setting of a road such as roadworks
A publication containing zero or more lane management setting description
A collection of information related to the Publication of Lane Management information
A publication containing one or more carriageway and lane management tables each comprising a set of records which hold details of how the lane management segments and sections are defined.
A collection of data relating to the publication of lane management information.
A collection of data and information constructs that are used only in the Lane Management package of the DATEX II model.

information describing the status of a dynamically managed portion of a carriageway, which can be implemented because of roadworks or any road condition and situation for which a lane transitability is changed with respect to its standard setting.
describes the lane setting
a set of dynamic lane management setting information related to a single road and carriageway/direction
A collection of the individual setting implemented for a dinamic lane management in set of managed segments

The information related to a specific lane setting, which can be associated to predefined segment and their sections described in a lane management table, or on not predefined sections such as in case of roadworks or a lane regulation for any purposes
A lane homogeneous road portion dynamically managed in a homogenous way. It can be associated to a linear location.
In a crossway or in the dynamically managed carriageway when lanes are merged or splitting, reference to the lanes to or from which the transitability is allowed.
the information related to the lane setting

in a crossway or in the same road when lanes are splitting, defines the lanes to which the transitability from the origin lane is allowed, when not implicit being in the sequence order described by the index
information describing the setting of a segment for carriageway lane management
The information related to a CLM subsegment setting
A collection of information related to the dynamic lane management
A versioned Carriageway Lane Management (CML) Table comprising a number of road zones divided in segments wher CLM is in place by means of devices /signs which allow a dynamic lane management

Defines the position of this lane within an ordered sequence of the lanes of one Section. The conventional order runs from the exterior to the centre of the carriageway as index numbers increase. It can be associated to a linear location.
Besides implicit connections in the sequence order described by indexes in sequencial sections, the reference to a linked lane in a crossway or in the same road when lane is merging or splitting
holds the reference to the linked segment, to or from which the associated segment drives

A continuous linear portion of road where lanes are uniformely managed by means of Dynamic Lane Management regulations, signs or devices, divided in homogeneous lanes and devices Sections. It can be associated to a linear location.

Portion of a managed segment of road which has homogeneous lane characteristics and lane management implemented by regulation, optionally implemented by lane control systems signs or static signs or other devices. It can be associated to a linear location
A continuous road portion, divided in one or more segment, where Dynamic Lane Management is done through specific regulations, signs and/or devices. It has to be associated to a linear location.
A collection of information related to static lane description which enable dynamic lane management in predefined road zones, eventually by means of specific devices, such as static Signs and VMS.
a class to specify a reference for a generic device
a reference for a VMS device
a class to reference a measeuremnet site
a reference for a VMS device, i.e. a single VMS associated to a VMS controller also specifying its index reference
a package to model devices from external packages

A class to reference and eventually associate any possible static or dynamic feature to segments, sub-segments and lanes such as static or dynamic road characteristics: e,g, road signs, ISAD level, functional road level, etc.
the Feature groups defines a combination of information which is applicable to one or more road elements and can be associated dinamically to them
defined in traffic regulation model
A collection of information related to correlate traffic management and traffic restriction configuration which can be applicable to road segments, section and lanes.
Setting status of lanes by the responsible authority based on standardised regulation
conventional transition considered for a lane when merging and splitting
A collection of enumerations that are used only in the LaneManagement package of the DATEX II model.
